values.value: Power Conversion 79729, Unstable Shield 79900 and Poison Soaked Shell 79835 proc on taken melee/ranged swings and on taken melee-, ranged-, none- and magic-class spell hits (proc flags 139944), not on periodic ticks. A landed spell hit without damage raises a NODAMAGE DamageInfo with PROC_SPELL_TYPE_NO_DMG_HEAL. Power Conversion's spell_proc rows (79729, 91543-91545; re-inserted by 2025_06_20_00 with Cooldown only) have SpellTypeMask 0, so a no-damage interrupt or taunt on Arcanotron under Power Conversion gives one Converted Power stack. Unstable Shield (79900, 91447-91449) and Poison Soaked Shell (79835, 91501-91503) keep their TDB 434.22011 rows with SpellTypeMask 1 (damage), which no later update removes, so CanSpellTriggerProcOnEvent (SpellMgr.cpp:542) rejects a no-damage hit before the Unstable Shield script's CheckProc runs: a taunt or interrupt procs no Static Shock and no Soaked In Poison; damaging hits do. Barrier 79582 is an absorb: any damage including periodic ticks depletes it, and depletion (or a dispel/steal) removes it by enemy spell, which casts Backdraft 79617 on the raid.
values.status: native_resolved; retail behaviour of no-damage procs open (research_completion power_conversion_no_damage_proc)
values.implementation_consequence: Offense restriction keeps shielded constructs out of every bot's allowed set; an interrupt or taunt on one is widened for that single cast only. The rotation keeps interrupting Arcanotron under Power Conversion (one Converted Power stack against a 39-41k Annihilator); a taunt costs a stack only on Arcanotron under Power Conversion. Damage focus leaves a construct alone well before its shield so DoTs expire first.
